cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Mid-tier builders install external mods easily, while facing challenging achievement unlocks.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that mods are available and easy to install, but point out that there is no built-in mod support or workshop integration through Steam.

citations.review_text: It's a good game, and pretty fun to just mess around. You can also make some fun scenarios and has lots of mods (which are easy to install but its not built in).
i love the game i wish i could get mods throgh steam

claims.claim: Reviewers describe achievements as difficult to obtain, noting that certain items or tools remain locked behind these achievements.

citations.review_text:
i really like this game
however 1 issue really pisses me off and really holds this game back especially with people who like to 100% their games
the achievements are stupidly annoying to get, this includes the worst of them: "get *number* upvotes in the workshop, this basically forces people to upload random garbage into the workshop which makes the workshop the worst thing ever to go through to look for something good or fun
other achievements in this game are extremely stupid and wild to get aswell, in fact even locking certain things behind these achievements which makes trying to enjoy the sandbox much much harder because you don't have access to every tool you can use

this is literally the only thing about this game i dislike and want to change desperately, remove the workshop achievements at the very least
Just great, can't wait for the next update! Although some achivements are very far fetched. Otherwise its fun :3

cohorts.summary: Long-term players notice stability limits when spawning massive populations.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game can crash if a very high number of mobs, such as 50,000, are spawned.

citations.review_text: it's fun don't put more than 50,000 mobs in the game or it'll crash

I've nuked the 6- 7 world, with erosion and high foliage enabled, many mutations, iceberg world scale, laggy modern box nukes, and 20 Crabzillas. Today, I'm very proud! I suggest you buy this game ASAP; It is worth your life's savings. :)
